compile.scope: ordinary compiler only; no package or manifest build

focused01.note: initial successful probe, extended only for identified delta/profile and rollback cases

limits: Tests invoke actual compiled ABG owners and actual append/recovery on new isolated fixture files. Historical candidate/lock/authority inputs are substituted for the native-D2 setup inputs; no package materialization, native provider, installed setup or qualification is claimed.
Precise inspector call coverage observes the real owner implementations; no validation, Event Calculus or I/O test double supplies the incremental-work result.

The candidate row is derived once before append and once after append; profile checking still copies event references and final projection still materializes/hash-serializes rows. No complete-history event/artifact reconstruction occurs in the three measured warm admissions.

Rollback test explicitly throws after staging an ordinary Public event and deriving artifact truth, then proves durable conservation, prior-prefix reconstruction and successful later binding. It is not an injected physical I/O failure test.
F_P, query/read-resource lifetime, other runtime ingress and native-D2 source/worksite/provider paths remain outside this slice.
